dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: I taught arithmetic at Chihu Rock for a few years, where my students were all kids from poor families.

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: Now I work at the Minghua Bank as Assistant Shopkeeper.

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: I am accompanying this young lady on her travels to make sure she stays safe.

dialogues.speaker: Jianqiu
dialogues.text: Heh. Just joking. I'm not supposed to let people know where we're headed, I'm afraid, sorry about that.
